## Showing up for our Community
"Whether it's serving as PTA president, leading a Cub Scout den, or just being a neighbor who shows up — I know that strong communities are built one relationship at a time. I'll bring that same commitment to the SMUHSD Board."
About me
## Meet Diana
For 18 years, I've taught in public elementary and middle schools including Meadow Heights Elementary School in San Mateo and Bowditch Middle School in Foster City. That experience has taught me how schools and districts really run, and given me a deep appreciation for the diversity that makes our schools strong.
I'm also an active parent in our schools. This is my 10th year serving on PTA Executive boards at Meadow Heights Elementary and Abbott Middle School, including four years as PTA president, where I've advocated for students while listening closely to the needs of teachers and families.
And I'm your neighbor. I grew up in Burlingame and have called San Mateo home since 2013. I help run several online community groups in our area, including Buy Nothing San Mateo Beresford/Laurelwood, and Meadow Heights Community because I love building connection and supporting the people around me. I'm also a Cub Scout Den Leader for Pack 27, teaching kids early what it means to give back and be active, contributing members of their community.
Why am I running?
## Because I care deeply about this community — and because my experience has prepared me to serve it well.
As a teacher in elementary and middle school classrooms, I've worked closely with administration and seen firsthand what students carry with them as they arrive at high school. As a PTA leader, I've made tough calls about funding the programs that support learning. And as a parent with a child at Hillsdale High School, I'm living the high school experience right now, advocating for my own children, and others, navigating our schools.
Together, that gives me a full view of what our students and families need, from the classrooms where they're shaped to the hallways where they're preparing for what's next. High school decisions don't start there, they're the culmination of everything before, and I've spent my career in that "before."
I've spent years committed to supporting education in our community. Now I want to bring that same commitment to the San Mateo Union High School District Board.
## Trustee Area 3
Trustee Area 3 spans San Mateo west of El Camino Real and Hillsborough, the neighborhoods I've called home, taught in, and raised my own children in. It's an honor to run to represent this community on the SMUHSD Board.

## Community Leaders Supporting Diana
Karen Sell - former Aragon HS PTSO Vice President, Borel/Baywood School Site Council
Colleen Sullivan - community leader
Marcella Cardoza McCollum - Hillsdale HS Parent
I have known Diana for over a decade and worked alongside her at the community, school, and district levels. Her deep knowledge, thoughtfulness, collaborative leadership, and unwavering commitment to students & families make her an exceptional leader.
Dr. Charles Hansen - San Mateo Union High School District Black Parent Association Board President
Jennifer Kawakami - teacher at Meadow Heights Elementary
Diana is one of the most dedicated and community-centered people I have had the privilege of knowing. She has consistently demonstrated an unwavering commitment to serving others through her work as an educator, her leadership as a parent advocate in local schools, her collaboration as a colleague, and her role as a parent.
Her breadth of experience provides her with a unique and well-rounded perspective on education, having engaged with our schools from multiple vantage points. Diana understands the needs of students, families, and educators alike, and she approaches every opportunity to serve with compassion, integrity, and purpose.
Diana is deeply committed to representing and supporting all members of our community. She values the rich diversity of San Mateo County and is dedicated to ensuring that every voice is heard, every family is welcomed, and every student has the opportunity to succeed. Her collaborative leadership, thoughtful decision-making, and genuine investment in the well-being of others make her an outstanding candidate for a Board position.
Karen Field - Hillsdale parent, San Mateo HS teacher
Rita Stephenson - Meadow Heights Parent
Diana Harris is an advocate for every child regardless which school he or she attends. She is an amazing educator who cares for the future of all our children!
Bennett Charles - parent at Meadow Heights & Abbott
"As a school parent I’ve personally witnessed her dedication and passion for helping children succeed. She has made major contributions to both Meadow Heights Elementary and Abbott Middle School. San Mateo families need a representative who not only has deep experience as a classroom educator, but who also has sent her children to all of our public schools, from elementary through middle school and high school.
Diana represents real San Mateo values of excellence and inclusion, and understands first-hand the needs of the very diverse range of families and students that live here. She is running an honest campaign, and does not represent ideologies that aren’t a match for San Mateo. I can’t imagine a better candidate for a school board."
